scope: matched native VT Unicode throughput, UTF-8 validation, symbol classification and grapheme appends; excludes rendering and physical input latency
method: Randomized paired AkiTTY/Ghostty order. Every sample compares active/history text, widths, styles, wrapping and cursor metadata after feeding and after narrow/restore resize. Rates use p50 feed time; resize is verified but excluded from throughput.

symbol_workload.baseline_scope: verdict-reuse candidate immediately before symbol classification expansion, not the 8ac2953 baseline

pty.scope: actual Akitty worker/model through the public request interface; 8 MiB fixture, three warmups and 11 samples; native-default grapheme mode

rejected_experiment: A 64-slot direct-mapped FNV cluster cache regressed complex emoji from 72.666 to 67.55 MiB/s and combining from 52.992 to 50.942 MiB/s, so the 16-slot exact-key cache was retained.
qualification: Engine and PTY rates do not establish full-app, renderer or physical-input parity with Ghostty.
